postal_system.assignment_rule: Latvijas Pasts postcode directories are the postal assignment authority. In Rīga they can enumerate street and house-number membership; elsewhere they can assign localities, municipalities, post offices, or special organizations. A directory row is not an official polygon.
postal_system.special_code_rule: Special organization and institution postcodes are non-areal unless an independent source explicitly supplies a valid service geometry.
postal_system.address_rule: The VZD State Address Register supplies official civic-address identity, codes, lifecycle, postcode attributes, coordinates, and cadastral relations. It does not replace Latvijas Pasts as postal assignment authority.
postal_system.postal_surface_rule: Only a current rights-cleared source Polygon/MultiPolygon, or an expressly authorized reproducible derivation from complete address-membership in a current Latvijas Pasts assignment denominator, may become a postcode surface; every derived surface remains noncanonical. VZD address points, point buffers, hulls, Voronoi/raster cells, administration, localities, roads, parcels and buildings are prohibited proxies.
postal_system.building_rule: VZD cadastral building contours supply building geometry. A building is exact only through a stable explicit Address Register or cadastral identifier relation; containment and nearest-footprint results remain candidates.
postal_system.administrative_rule: VZD administrative boundaries, villages, and road centerlines add context but cannot create, clip, or replace a Latvijas Pasts postcode assignment.
postal_system.territory_rule: All published features must remain within Latvia's LV country partition; adjacent Estonia, Lithuania, Russia, and Belarus geometry must never be absorbed by border interpolation.

temporal_model.valid_time: Postal assignment and address-object lifecycle dates when published by the source.
temporal_model.known_time: Ingest, correction, and source-publication timestamps retained separately.
temporal_model.history_rule: Current and historical VZD records remain versioned; a later postcode assignment never rewrites an earlier release.

quality_gates.pass: A current complete Latvijas Pasts assignment denominator and explicit AGID processing, public serving and redistribution rights are pinned by version, date, byte length and SHA-256.
Every promoted Polygon/MultiPolygon has authoritative postcode meaning, valid topology, declared code-class coverage and reproducible lineage.
VZD address points and organization, institution, post-office, PO-box and route records remain non-areal and are never buffered, hulled or tessellated.
Administrative, locality, road, parcel and building geometry stays context-only; an exact building relation requires an explicit stable source link.
No recipient, resident, owner, tenant, customer, credential, private-unit occupant, cadastral subject or land-right record is published.
Synthetic fixtures test behavior but never satisfy production evidence gates.

stages.definition: Source roles, rights, coverage, and blockers are inventoried.
Contracts and synthetic conformance fixtures are reviewable.

A current complete rights-cleared Latvijas Pasts postcode assignment denominator, code-class exceptions and real postcode Polygon/MultiPolygon surfaces are pinned by edition or retrieval basis, effective date, terms, byte length and SHA-256, published as an approved immutable artifact, and loaded through the real LV API/app so a normalized LV-NNNN search fits and renders a translucent area with a clear outline, selected code, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual classification, source, reference date and confidence. Latvijas Pasts tables, VZD address points, organization/institution/post-office/PO-box/route endpoints, administrative or locality polygons, roads, parcels, buildings, point buffers, hulls, Voronoi/raster cells and synthetic fixtures never satisfy M2 by themselves. A derived surface is eligible only from an expressly authorized complete current postal assignment denominator with reproducible lineage, limitations and noncanonical status preserved.
Holdout, topology, ambiguity, privacy, freshness, and correction gates pass.
Two source refreshes pass and monitored rollback operates.
